reviews.comment: Rooms were small but tidy, lobby was simple and comfortable, showers were pretty spacious and very hot. Bathrooms were clean and the street was mostly quiet. Staff seemed very nice. Power went out while we were there but we made the most of it. Kitchen was small but had most of the essentials. Tons of restaurants and stores close by. Location was convenient and safe. It was a small space but overall a good deal for the price.

I stayed in a 4 bed mixed dorm for 5 nights.

Pro- location is a 5-10 minute walk to Taksim Square from which the metro and funicular can be accessed to any area of the city. Price is affordable at around $10 per night (although there are many other hostels with a similar price point in the city also). Staff members were friendly, respectful and professional. Mattress and pillow were comfortable. Locker and individual hanger space provided the necessary space for all belongings (key included). Towel was included free of charge as was daily cleaning of each bed. If you don’t want your bed made or things moved around, just put a handmade sign on your bed! Place feels secure with a key code entry into the building and key card for individual room access. First floor common area is bright and spacious for socializing. Structure of the building is unique with the spiral staircase.

Challenges- First floor bathroom needs some work. The shower door was missing as was a holder for the shower head. Equally the toilet seat wouldn’t stay vertical and had to be manually held up. Kitchen could be improved. Located on the top floor, there was a water kettle, pots, pans, along with plates, cups and cutlery. However, there are no appliances for cooking with said items. Also, there was no space to eat apart from a table with 2 chairs on the outdoor balcony which is open to the weather elements. The cutlery drawer needs some repair as well as exposed nails are the primary way of opening the drawer. This is a simple fix along with repairing the shower door mentioned above that would be welcome. One last point is that in the 4 bed dorm, it is a 2 x 2 configuration. The top beds are easily accessible via the ladder with a cubby space and individual power socket. However, for the sleep rollers that are out there, a metal bar on the side of the bed would be a great addition so no one falls the 2 meters to the ground in the night.

It must be mentioned that the power was out for 2/5 mornings, making it an inconvenience and challenge to use the bathrooms or use the stairways safely due to the subsequent darkness. Not sure of the cause, but if this is a regular occurrence, it would be nice to have storm lights or something similar at the ready to place on each floor to help guests navigate when such times arise.

I recently stayed at Stayinn Taxim and had a wonderful experience. The hostel is ideally located in the heart of the city, making it easy to explore local attractions, shops, and restaurants. The common areas were clean and inviting, creating a relaxed atmosphere that encouraged socializing with fellow travelers. My room was comfortable and well-maintained, providing a peaceful retreat after busy days of sightseeing. The blend of affordability, convenience, and a warm community spirit makes Stayinn Taxim a perfect choice for both solo travelers and groups.

Overall, I highly recommend Stayinn Taxim for anyone looking for a budget-friendly, comfortable, and centrally located hostel experience.

reviews.comment:
I booked a regular room on Booking.com. Since I am not able to leave review on that platform as Hotel closed that option I am leaving feedback here. Therefore rating on booking.com is completely misleading since genuine customers can’t leave feedback.

When I choose place to stay I keep attention to certain details.

In the description it was mentioned: soundproof, view, city view.

View - I expected to have a window as on the photos. However they gave a room without a window. Tiny one. The wall separating it from the next room was made of paper. I could hear absolutely everything what was happening there. After back and forth messages with manager they agreed to give me a room with the window. Solution - list room without a window as a separate option and a cheaper one. People who prefer to save money will choose it willingly, knowing that there is no window. It is a bad strategy give those rooms to customers and if they complain fix the situation.

Soundproof - please remove this statement from your description as it’s absolutely misleading. I could hear everything what was happening in the room next to mine. Running water, people switching on and off lights and all what they were talking about and not only that. Windows were not properly adjusted and closed so I could hear everything what was happening outside as well.

Some good points: Clean, white towels and bedding, hot water. The area is very local and isn’t pretty but it’s convenient, in the central part of the city, easy access to everything.

reviews.comment:
I stayed at Rodin Hostel for two nights. The staff were genuinely kind and helpful, and I appreciated their warm welcome from the moment I arrived. The location was perfect. However, I believe there’s room for improvement in terms of facilities and space management.

The hostel is quite small. I stayed in the 4-bed room, and I found the space very limited—there was barely enough room for three people to stand or move comfortably. Changing clothes or organizing personal items was difficult due to the lack of space. The bathroom is very close to the beds, with no real sound insulation, which can be uncomfortable for some guests.

The kitchen is shared and is located in the same area as the reception, which makes it feel even more compact. There's a small common area to relax, or work remotely.

If you're just looking for a place to sleep for a night or two and don’t mind tight spaces, this could be a suitable option. However, if you value comfort, space, or more complete facilities, you might want to explore other alternatives.

Very basic and rustic place for a cheap night not more. Small common area with a dirty kitchen and long terms hanging out and smoking at weird times. Food gets stolen from the fridge and rooms so better have a padlock with you.

Note: after reading the reply of my review, it’s good that you are taking legal actions against me. Does it mean that you didn’t register my stay and hosted me illegally? Please, keep the record of the camera of the hostel, so the interested parts will see that I both stayed there and didn’t bother any guest. It’s so easy to treat someone that leaves a bad review as a mental problem person… By the way, I have the proof of the cash withdrawal at 11pm when you asked me to pay again before leaving after you kicked me out and wanted to charge me anyway, and that I had to go back to the reception to receive back the US$40 I paid in the check-in moment. Keep it also to prove that I left without provoking any chaos or mistreating anyone. Thank you!

-

Super weird thing happened: as soon as I paid in cash, the receptionist Hussein cancelled my booking in Booking.com and said that it was because didn’t put my correct credit card in Booking.com (and I would had received US$10 of cashback from that booking) and he didn’t want to help in none of the ways I asked him to help, and my first request was simply to send me a message saying that I paid for my stay (since I didn’t have any receipt or proof to send to Booking.com and revert my cancellation). I also asked him if it’s ok for me to book again in Booking.com, and he said that he would charge me the double.

I didn’t bother other guests, and I was really tired, but I was not disrespectful towards him, but from nothing he asked me to leave from the hostel at 11pm in front of other guests and he still wanted to charge me even having kicked me out. He wanted to stay with my US$40 that previously I had paid for 4 nights, even after I additionally paid in Turkish lira for the 1 night (or 2 hours that I used the bed before being kicked out), but luckily after some time he gave me my money back and allowed me to sleep there almost at midnight. I wish the owner was there. This hostel had better staff last year, when I also met the owner in person, named “Hakan” or something close to this pronunciation.

I didn’t understand if he was trying to host me “illegally” by not registering me and get this money from the owner, or for another reason.

This situation was just so nonsensical and unnecessarily uncomfortable…

Booking.com confirmed that they cancelled my booking without noticing me before, and I was in the hostel by that time, and Hussein didn’t ask me to update my credit card in the system (if it’s so important, even after I had already paid the entire amount in cash):
“They have a button to cancel your reservation on Booking.com's system if there is no new credit card being updated. We already filed your claim and reported to the relevant team.”

Update: hostel claims they don't have such a room, see comment under this review. I've added a picture of the room (we had the middle room). It certainly fits their communication style to reply like this.

Unfortunately, our experience with Rodin Hostel was very disappointing. Started all good and well, nice location, friendly welcome. Everything that you can expect from a budget hostel, and surprisingly quiet for its location.

However, on our second morning, the curtain rails broke down, revealing substantial mold stains on the walls and around the windows, next to the bed.

In the morning we were assured by the volunteer a new room would be provided for us and we could leave our luggage. The volunteer was super kind, but the only staff around.

That evening unfortunately, the hostel manager did not resolve the situation and became very defensive. He used the fact that the hostel is mostly run by volunteers as an excuse for not having to take the responsibility. He did not seem to be bothered by this health hazard and made comments such as: 'it's a budget hostel, what do you expect?' and  'if I give you your money back, all customers will want their money back.'

We resolved the situation ourselves by booking another hostel for the night. Asking to settle this financially, he said: 'we have a no refund policy...'

Even the nights that we did not sleep there but already paid, we did not get refunded. The manager said we should settle this with @HostelWorld as we booked it through their platform. So far, they have only offered us an embarrassing €11 voucher of their services as 'a gesture of goodwill under exceptional circumstances'. Let's see where this ends up.

You have to pay upon arrival, so if you stay here, make sure to see the room before paying.  Also, plenty of nice alternative budget hostels around.

name: Black Art Hotel
location: Bostan, Yaya Köprüsü Sk. NO:18, 34435 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: The Black Art Hotel in Istanbul is an amazing place to stay, not just for its comfortable accommodations but also for its exceptional hospitality. The management and staff are incredibly kind, welcoming, and always ready to help. During my stay, they went above and beyond, especially when I fell ill they showed genuine care and provided support when I needed it most. Their warmth and attentiveness made me feel at home. If you’re visiting Istanbul, I highly recommend this hotel for its outstanding service and wonderful team.

I spent 15 unforgettable days in Istanbul and was recommended to stay at Black Hat Hotel—and I’m so glad I did. From the moment I arrived to the moment I left, the experience was nothing short of amazing.

The staff made me feel like family. The manager and shift manager were incredibly kind, welcoming, and always ready to help. They’re full of helpful information and genuinely care about making your stay comfortable. Every interaction felt warm and sincere.

Black Hat Hotel is a cozy little gem tucked away in the heart of Istanbul. It gives you an authentic feel of Turkish culture—peaceful, warm, and full of character. The breakfast each morning was fresh and delicious, and they were more than happy to accommodate my preferences. That personal touch made all the difference.

The location is perfect—within walking distance of great restaurants, with taxis right at your doorstep, and just minutes from Taksim Square. The rooms are cozy and comfortable. Yes, the hotel has a bit of an old-school charm, but that only added to its personality. It truly felt like a home away from home.

I want to thank everyone at Black Hat Hotel—from the kind souls at the front desk to the lovely cleaning staff and the amazing chef. Your hospitality warmed my heart. Thank you for making my time in Turkey so special.

May your business continue to grow and be blessed.
With heartfelt thanks,
Kendra

We spent three nights here.
It was a nice experience, we felt good.
The price was low te breakfast was included, and the locatiin suited us as we like to walk, and observe.

It was a very nice hotel with a great location near the most famous attractions and a bus station close by. The service was excellent and helpful, and their breakfast was the best. Thank you! ✨🌼

name: YENİ HOTEL
location: Hocapaşa mah.Nöbethane Cad.Dervişler Sok. No:12 Sirkeci Eminönü, Hoca Paşa, 34112 FATİH/Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Very basic hotel and may be max. 1 star. No services as usual but a bit cheap considering the proximity to the historic places, transport and food.

People of the hotel are well behaved and good. The downside is there is no lift.

You can stay here if you like to leave the comfort behind comparing the price. Value for money for budget travellers.
Great hotel. Really friendly and helpful staff. I had a great time at the yeni hotel, close to the station and the main attractions. Top

Located right at the city centre, highly accessible to istanbul extensive public transport. Plenty of restaurants nearby. Smooth check in/out process, friendly owner in charge. I booked a room with a shared bathroom, everything was perfect, surprisingly very clean hotel. Bear in mind that this hotel is not equipped with elevator but not a problem for me. Good experience, recommended.
Perfect for my needs, shared bathroom worked fine. Not once did I have to wait for the bathroom or the shower. I paid $27 per night, you won't find a lower price in the neighborhood.

As a solo female traveller, I am delighted. I felt safe, comfortable and welcome at Yeni Hotel.
I came to Istanbul for the first time, and loved this hotel, both for its excellent location in Sirkeci, and the staff and facilities. My room was quiet, clean and charming, just what I wanted for exploring the city on a budget and having somewhere to rest as well with AC. I'd recommend the private bathroom. There are no elevators, but you get used to the stairs pretty quickly - it's a good warmup for the streets of Istanbul afterwards. I arrived at 6am and was allowed early checkin as requested, and got help with my luggage/adapters/questions etc. Residents were polite, and Mohammad at the reception was exceptionally helpful and welcoming, as well as the owners. The restaurants, shops and stations around make for a colorful, lively and laid back area, super convenient during the day or late at night. Chef Ramo right next door is great for eating and chilling as you plan your day. The hotel will also help you book taxis if you need.

name: Rota Star Hotel Beyoğlu

The breakfast is served on a plate, and it's absolutely delicious. Highly recommend for a relaxing stay!

The breakfast served as a plate was delicious and just the right portion to start the day. The room was spotless, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive. It was a comfortable and welcoming stay. Thank you!

Bright, crowded and safe at nights. Metro access is 10 minute walking. Also very polite and friendly reception and stuff

Unless you are short on money, it is not a good choice.

I never expected hotel to be that bad. It was very dirty to extent that I found garbage in the cabinet next to the bed (they didn’t even bother to throw the garbage out). name: THE TRiP İSTANBUL HOTEL
location: Şehsuvar Bey, Arapzade Ahmet Sk. NO:09/A, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
An excellent option for its price. The location is great—you can walk to all the major sights. However, there is no metro station nearby; it takes about 15 minutes to get there. The rooms are very clean, with excellent housekeeping. The beds are comfortable, and slippers are even provided.

During our stay, the weather was bad, and the room felt cold, but the reception staff promptly turned on the heating and adjusted the hot water to be warmer. Ramazan was very welcoming and friendly. He offers a variety of excursions at good prices. We also booked a transfer, which was super comfortable and reasonably priced. In the evening, the Wi-Fi was a bit slow, probably due to high usage. Overall, it’s a great value for the price! If they added a couple of glasses to the room and improved the Wi-Fi speed, it would easily deserve a perfect 10!

The hotel does not stand out for luxury, but yes for hygiene, functionality and service, we were received by agent Ramazan, thanks to him he gave us an excellent treatment and a guide and received us with a wonderful attention!

Thank you very much. Wanted was nice, clean and close by 5-10 minutes from GrandBazaar; Aya Sofia, Sultan Ahmed Mosque, Laleli market and metro.
The service of the managers were excellent. Especially Mr. Ramazan. He was very polite and tried to help with every question.
Ramazan organized us a tour to Bursa. It was also an unforgettable tour.
In short I was satisfied 😊
Very nice hotel, with very nice people. Ramazan and Mehmet are the best, they will help you with everything you need on any time! Clean rooms and top location! I recommend this for everyone to come.

Great experience right in the heart of old Istanbul. Clean, light, and cozy space. All the historical landmarks can be reached by feet, as well as restarted, and markets.

I wanted to say special gratitude to Ramazan, being so kind, friendly, and helpful, that definitely made our stay perfect! He helped to find our way to/from the airport, helped book transfers, and provided a detailed recommendations for the city.

The rooms are too dirty(and bugs everywhere) and there are stories of abuse and rape attempts; there are also bar noises till the morning, so totally awful experience...Never advised for either solo or group.

reviews.comment:

Very clean bathroom, no mold, it felt like it had been renovated recently. The refrigerator and kettle were very useful. We went up to the terrace and had breakfast there. Of course, the location is great! We ate several times at the Dimbil Restaurant, it was delicious and inexpensive (from the hotel, 30-50 meters to the right, the restaurant will be the first on the left). Once a week (Wednesday or Thursday) there is a street mini-bazaar next to the hotel, where you can buy Turkish sweets much cheaper than in the Egyptian and Grand Bazaars (about 100 meters to the left of the hotel).

Disadvantages. Terrible pillows. They are just lumps in a pillowcase. The door to the balcony did not close tightly, on the first night the sounds were very disturbing until 2 am - screams, noise, barking dogs. But from the second night we slept well, because we were very tired. These downsides didn't spoil the impression, so I give it the highest score.
Value for money, except there is no lift and have to climb up to 4th floor.

We are unhappy with our stay. Also though we had a window, they view was of a bunch of ac fans.

name: MUSK HOTEL
location: İnönü, Akkarga Sk. No:3, 34295 Şişli/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Finding a hotel in Istanbul that fits within a tight budget is easier said than done. Many Airbnbs, for example, can go for 35€ a day, and a room without hot water is not unusual. My fiancé and I decided to book a relatively cheap hotel, expecting to run into some issues regarding comfort.

We arrived at the hotel, and the staff took us to our room. Immediately, we were pleasantly surprised. The room was warm and smelled amazing, overall tidy, and the shower area was perfect. The water temperature was just what we wanted, the shower had good pressure, and the shampoo smelled amazing. The view was also something we really liked. The hotel’s location was about two minutes from a small shop, and if we wanted to go anywhere else, the bus stop was within a five-minute walk.

The best part of our hotel experience was still the friendly staff. They told us to ask for anything we needed—something smaller hotels usually say to make guests more comfortable, without actually delivering good service—but this time, they really meant it. For example, we needed an outlet adapter for some of our devices. Five minutes later, we got a knock on our door, and now we had an adapter. They offered us drinks and bread in the upstairs kitchen area, which was available to all guests for free. Every time we went downstairs, they greeted and chatted with us like we were part of their family. They also mentioned that the hotel used to have just the owner working there by himself, which had cased some issues with communication before, this is not the case anymore at all!

It is very rare to feel at home in a hotel, but here, that was the case. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to stay in Istanbul.

There was only one guy in the reception and maybe he is the owner too i don't know and he kicked me out of the room in the middle of the night. After a 17 hours of flight, i made it there and no one expect such experience.

Hotel was very affordable, and for that price really you cant ask for more.

Restraint of this hotel was expensive, and would not recommend dining there for that reason only. You have much more affordable places just little outside of this place.  Like, bottle of water was 4,2$. That is just ridiculous. Food was very good though.

Fantastic location, basic rooms with the essentials, and decent simple breakfast, but the shower water and Wi-fi both suffered from consistency issues. Still pretty nice for the price (roughly 60 USD per night for the smallest room prepaid in August 2023).

Without even moving the handle, the shower water oscillates between scalding hot and lukewarm. The Wi-fi connection to the internet is also spotty, which is inconvenient.

I booked our stay on Airbnb and was very happy with our stay. The Hotel is located less than five minutes to all the major must do attractions. It's in the middle of everything. Hotel staff were very kind and attentive. Staff greeted our taxi as we arrived and carried our luggage upstairs. The hotel provided breakfast which was delicious. The staff gave us tips on where to go and how to avoid ploys geared to tourists. They also called us a taxi that gave us a better rate to the airport on the way out. The room was clean and well serviced and we felt very safe. I would highly recommend, you won't find a better place for such a low price. It was a good deal, very good value. We would also recommend the restaurant that can be found in the basement of the hotel. As a guest of the hotel, they wave the taxes on the food. It was also wonderful.

name: Grand Tower Hotel
location: Saraç İshak, Tiyatro Cd. No:44, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
recently stayed at this hotel and had one of the worst experiences I’ve ever heard of. I feel compelled to share on their behalf to help others avoid the same mistake.

To begin with, the food was absolutely terrible — not only poorly prepared and lacking in variety, but clearly not fresh. Every meal was a disappointment, and some dishes even seemed unsafe to eat.

The hotel room was in a shocking condition. The air conditioning didn’t work at all, leaving the room freezing cold. On top of that, the walls were so thin that every noise from adjacent rooms and the hallway could be heard — conversations, footsteps, even running water. Resting or sleeping was nearly impossible due to the constant disturbance.

Cleanliness was a major concern. The room had not been properly cleaned before check-in, and the bathroom in particular was disgusting. There was a persistent, overpowering stench coming from the toilet area that made it hard to even breathe. My friend described feeling sick to their stomach every time they had to use it.

Perhaps worst of all was the hotel’s lack of accountability. They were initially told that it would be possible to check out a day early without penalty — something that was clearly agreed upon. However, when they actually tried to leave, the hotel completely went back on their word and refused to refund or accommodate the change. It felt dishonest and unprofessional.

In short, the experience was miserable from start to finish. Based on everything my friend went through, I would strongly discourage anyone from booking this hotel. It was not only uncomfortable, but also incredibly frustrating and disappointing in every possible way.

I had an extremely unpleasant experience at this hotel and would strongly advise others to avoid it. The food provided was of the poorest quality—stale, cold, and clearly not fresh. It was nearly inedible and made me feel unwell.

The room conditions were equally disappointing. The air conditioning system was completely broken, and the room was freezing cold throughout the night. Additionally, the room was incredibly noisy, with thin walls that offered no sound insulation. I could hear conversations, footsteps, and even water running from neighboring rooms, making it impossible to get any rest.

Cleanliness was another major issue. The room was dirty and poorly maintained, with dust and stains everywhere. The bathroom was especially unbearable—it had a strong, persistent foul odor that was nauseating. The overall hygiene standard was far below acceptable.

To make matters worse, the hotel showed a complete lack of professionalism and integrity. I had received confirmation that I could check out one day earlier than planned without penalty. However, when I tried to proceed with the early checkout, the management completely denied the agreement and refused to honor their word.

This stay was truly distressing from start to finish. I urge potential guests to think twice before booking this hotel—you will likely regret it as I did.

The condition of the room was unacceptable. The air conditioning system was broken, leaving the room extremely cold and uncomfortable. There was also a significant noise problem — the walls offered little to no sound insulation, so they were constantly disturbed by noises from other rooms and the corridor. It was nearly impossible to get a good night’s sleep.

Cleanliness and hygiene were clearly not priorities at this hotel. The room was dusty and unkempt, and the bathroom was especially unpleasant. There was a persistent and intense odor coming from the toilet area that made it difficult to stay in the room for long without feeling nauseous.

To make matters worse, the hotel’s management failed to honor a prior agreement. They had clearly stated that early checkout was allowed with a one-day notice, but when it was time to check out early, the hotel completely denied the agreement and refused to issue any refund or compensation. This showed a serious lack of professionalism and integrity.

All in all, based on their experience, I would strongly advise anyone considering this hotel to think twice. The poor facilities, lack of cleanliness, and untrustworthy service make it a place best avoided.

Pros:
The hotel has a great location, close to many of Istanbul’s main attractions, which makes it convenient for sightseeing. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, and the front desk staff were polite and helpful.

Cons:
Unfortunately, there was no Wi-Fi available during our stay. Upon arrival, we were told that the internet was temporarily down and would be fixed in a day or two. However, nearby shopkeepers and another receptionist confirmed that Wi-Fi had not been available for quite some time, which is unacceptable for a modern hotel.

Breakfast was another disappointment. If you arrive around 8:00 AM, the selection is decent, but if you come after 9:00, there’s hardly anything left to eat. This creates a poor experience, especially for guests who prefer a more relaxed morning schedule.

Conclusion:
The Grand Tower Hotel has potential and benefits from a great location, but it urgently needs to improve its services—especially Wi-Fi availability and breakfast management. Until then, I would hesitate to recommend it to travelers planning a longer stay or needing reliable internet access.

The hotel turned out to be very bad. Upon arrival,i was in May, from 1 to 4, there was no wi-fi and the problem could not be solved. To the question, how do you plan to resolve this issue? at the reception, they threw up their hands and said they couldn't do anything, it was all a problem for the mobile operator. The rooms are tired, the air conditioner did not work (I spoke more than once at the reception, no one eventually fixed the problem). The cleaning was bad, they only took out the trash, the towels were not changed for all 3 days even once. Breakfast is very modest and not very tasty, if you arrive a little later than 8, then there is nothing to choose from, no additional food is added. I do not recommend this hotel for check-in

name: THE CENTRAL HOTEL
location: Haseki Sultan, Turgut Özal Millet Cd no:47, 34096 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Very nice budget hotel, exactly next to the tram stop. Rooms were very nice quality, clean, personel kind and welcoming, a little short in their english, but we found the way to comunicate. I would repeat!

I really want to thank all the staff who are working in the hotel, starting from the manager who I forgot his name, the cleaners, the waitresses. They all were very helpful. The breakfast was fine, no variety. The place were you have the breakfast is small and it needs better ventilation. The rooms are super small, not as small as I expected 😅. The location is perfect, you can find everything you might need in your area.In general, I do recommend it.
Abdurrahman really nice guy. He was there all night at reception and helped us answering all our questions! Thank you!
Hi the central hotel good for location plus reasonable price
It is a good place if you come and want a good price for your trip without extensions , It is in front of the tramway station and nearby everything

name: Mahya Hotel
location: Nişanca, Molataşı Cd. No:78, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Horrible location! I have chosen this hotel because it was relatively cheap and very close to all local sites, but that was a mistake . First of all, the Pictures on Expedia around the hotel are blurred, why? Because it is literary a local market around. As a man I felt fine, but my wife couldn’t walk normally there, she felt unsafe! So, if you here because you trying to save some money on the hotel, don’t do it , it’s not worth it. There is definitely a better options! By the way when I made a reservation (3-4 months prior to my travel) and then 30-40 minutes later changed my mind, because found better option, I was told that it’s not refundable. Okay, what about the hotel itself? I was given the smallest room I have ever seen!!! It was maybe 3 meters in length, we could barely walk there! You know the best part? Room didn’t have a window!!!!! Water from the sink sometimes was orange! The first day there i asked receptionist, is there something we can do about window, and he said yes, comeback in like 1-2 days I will give you a little bigger room. When we came and asked 2 days later, I was told , that I will get different room only if I pay more 😂. I had reservation for like 22 nights, but after 4 days there we couldn’t stand that place anymore, some we left to another hotel and then only came back at the end to check out and pick up some stuff. Overall would not recommend to anyone!!!!!!

Beautiful hotel in a nice location. Not far from the bazaar. The breakfast was delicious. The woman who works there in the morning is very friendly. Also the staff at the reception very friendly and support. Only the elevator makes a lot of noise. The hotel is located in a street where you can buy cheap brand clothing and you have delicious restaurants. Definitely worth it for the next time. But hopefully not next to the elevator.

This hotel is newer from the outside and parts of the inside, but definitely has some work to be done.

One of the most inexpensive hotels we’ve ever stayed in our life at $30 per night in March.

But still, I wanna tell you the honest truth about their rooms and the buffet : at first, I got room 105 on the first floor and it didn’t have a view out to the street just next to another building and I had bars in the window. It felt safe, but it definitely looked sketch. I was able to move to the top floor room 302. It had a beautiful view of the streets down below and markets. The problem is you can hear every single sound every conversation every dog bark every car up until around 4 AM. That’s when it gets quiet. Had to sleep with the window open because the AC did not seem to work.

Also, because the elevator door is metal every time somebody comes onto the floor you can hear it bang because it’s kind of heavy. This was extremely annoying at all hours of the night.

At least for my room in 302 There’s water damage all over the room walls
From cracked walls to peeling wallpaper, and the bathroom smells like mold, if that door is closed it’s absolutely disgusting when you walk in. They should keep the window and that door open before people arrive. It’s absolutely disgusting. I didn’t see Physical mold some black corners tho so maybe that is it, I didn’t wanna put my face close to it to get a better look… I wear shoes in the shower at all times and kept the door open. The shower is very hot. It’s very nice.

Take a look at my pictures to see the reality of the rooms because they look good on the outside, but I made sure to show you what it looks like in reality.

Also, not sure if this is a rat trapper in my room, but it was very concerning. There was nothing inside it and there was no mice or rats around, but why would you leave this here??

The breakfast is absolutely disappointing. There’s some hot food, but it did not look appetizing to me personally there’s more bread, no cucumbers, not enough veggies. I literally would just have olives and bread. Other hotels have more variety.

Overall, this was the cheapest place to stay so we can have more money to spend on food elsewhere, it would take some convincing, but I would probably stay one more night here. Make sure I was really tired to fall asleep.

The location is good but the room smells bad. There was a odor of sewage. The bed is too small. There was no blackout on the window. I asked if it was possible to change the room but they did not allowed. I would pay more for it if it was necessary cause I would stay 6 days but they did not helped. I decided to move to another hotel after I stayed 2 days there.
Great hotel with a great price performance ratio. Staffs are helpful, breakfast is better than average. Place is calm and close to touristic places.

name: Birlik Apart
location: Molla Hüsrev, Akif Paşa Sk. No:11, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Budget hotel- perfect for us as we wanted to spend the majority of time out "touristing". 2 adults and 11 year old. Friendly, kind staff. Clean room and hotel. WiFi good. Stayed 4 days. Towels changed and room cleaned daily. Carpets and decor tired and dated. But not a bother to me. We were on 4th floor and no lift but tbh I valued the exercise throughout our trip 🤣. I would definitely stay again.

I think the hotel needs simple renovation like changing shaver cabins because they are so mouldy and also terring off dirty, stained carpet covering hall and the stairs. The bed linen was not changed by 2 weeks of my staying there. Cleaning lady very moody. Table matts in the restaurant sticky and dirty. Reception staff very helpful,but the hotel in fact is just quite dirty. I would not book it again.

Ruuun away! now, so that it is not too late!

terrible, I booked a vacation with loveholidays for 7 days, they don't want to refund me at all, I didn't enjoy the vacation at all, I just had stress with the hotel, people you simply can't get along with, just because that he gave us a bigger room with two more small beds that we didn't need at all, on the highest level, without an elevator, they think that I don't have the right to return. Miserable! that's all I can say, an exaggerated price for the conditions, no breakfast  nothing!

Deceptive Practices and Disappointing Stay - Avoid This Place if you can

Liked · The only redeeming aspects of this stay were the elderly owner, who was polite and helped us with our luggage on the day we left, and the breakfast, which had fresh baked goods. Unfortunately, these small positives were completely overshadowed by the unprofessionalism, dishonesty, and discomfort we experienced.

Disliked · Our stay at Berlik Apart Hotel from September 8th to 14th was awful. We had two bookings: one for three people from the 8th to 11th and another for two people from the 11th to 18th, as my brother was leaving early. Unfortunately, it turned into a nightmare.

Early Check-In Scam
Before arriving, we confirmed an early check-in for September 8th, but when we arrived, they charged us an unexpected 50 euros, despite no mention of this in our communication. It felt like we were being scammed from the start.

Demand for Full Payment
On September 9th, the hotel’s young son rudely forced us to pay upfront for both reservations, even though they should have been handled separately. They also made us pay the 50-euro early check-in fee again.

No Soundproofing
The room was far from soundproof. We could hear other guests talking constantly, and a woman was crying regularly, which added to an uncomfortable and eerie atmosphere.

Dishonest Management
When my brother left early, we tried to cancel our second booking. The father (who only speaks Turkish) agreed to a refund minus a 12% fee. However, the son (who spoke English) tried to charge us a 20% fee. When I mentioned I understood Turkish and knew what the father had said, the son was shocked and refused to refund anything.

Forced to Stay
We were forced to stay and eventually left early on September 14th, incurring extra costs to change our flights.

The Few Positives
The only redeeming aspects of this stay were the elderly owner, who was polite and helped us with our luggage on the day we left, and the breakfast, which had fresh baked goods. Unfortunately, these small positives were completely overshadowed by the unprofessionalism, dishonesty, and discomfort we experienced.

Avoid this place if you can!

Location and decent breakfasts are the only good things about this hotel. First night we got in room with toilet under shower, with view to some strange room (storage?). Second day room was changed, but the bathroom was a disaster here as well. Walls looked like never cleaned and ventilation was coming INTO our bathroom so everytime you got in you have to smell other rooms toilets. No elevator. Very loud school nearby. Totally would not recommend.

reviews.comment:

DO NOT BOOK.

Electric cables exposed various parts of the room.

Stinks of sewerage and smoke.

It's actually not too bad. I would give it 3 stars because price/quality is just average, but I give it 2 stars because I booked by their website (which is used on Google maps and their business card) and because the price on their website was a lot cheaper. They told me it was fake. They allowed me to still book the room for a 100 extra. But didn't tell me it was for 1 night instead of 2. Which I booked it for. Eventually the price became double. The place feels a bit like a scam.

Even though it's on the lower ends of the Asia side. I would recommend paying a little bit more or going to Europe. It will give a lot more bang for your buck

I wholeheartedly do not recommend you to come here if you have at least a minimum of other options!

And this is why:

1. you pay for a two-star hotel, but in the end you get a shabby dorm with holes in the floor, cockroaches and a toilet that leaks water into the room

🙌🏻 my advice add 200 lira on top and rent an apartment or hotel on any nearby street

2. absolutely no soundproofing, you will hear everything, absolutely everything and always

3. on the first floor there is a Turkish night club, and across the road there is a construction (see point 2 and the video I attached - filmed at 3:40 - sound in the room)

and I understand everything about the economic situation in Turkey and that prices are rising monthly and it is very difficult for people, but this is absolutely no reason to provide guests of a city this level of housing for 1100-1500 lira per night

I would recommend this hotel to anyone wishing to visit Kadiköy. The location is perfect, not only is it nearby many shops and restaurants, but also right around the corner to the main bus station that includes a connection to the airport. The views are unfortunately lacking, but in my opinion the location compensates for this. The owner is very friendly and conversational :)). He only purchased this hotel a few months ago so some things are still under renovation, however we had a very pleasant experience here regardless.
Stay away from this place. If you need to sleep, better to sleep on the street.

name: Hanchi Hostel
location: Muhsine Hatun, Samsa Sk. No:11, 34130 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
Rude, discriminatory staff and horrible experience

This was one of the worst hotel stays we’ve ever had. The reception staff were extremely rude and arrogant — you could clearly feel their discriminatory attitude. One guy in particular — a skinny, short man (possibly named Vulkan or something like that) — was the worst. He completely ignored our questions, walked away on purpose, and made us wait for hours, while he was happily checking in other guests without any delay.

We arrived at 2 PM, and he told us our room wasn’t ready. We ended up waiting until almost 6 PM, while other guests — especially certain nationalities — were checked in immediately. Later, we found out that the room we had booked was given to someone else.

All the receptionists were extremely cold, unfriendly, and seemed depressed. They never answered questions properly and clearly didn’t care about anything.

The hotel is also located in a very noisy and confusing area. It was hard to even find the address — not clear on maps, and the surroundings felt unsafe. In the evenings, strange people gathered on balconies, smoking, shouting, and even fighting through the night. No security, no rules, and the staff just didn’t care.

When we asked questions, they responded with things like, “Why are you asking me? How should I know?” That kind of attitude says it all.

We will definitely never return and do not recommend this place to anyone.
And breakfast is so horrible

Hanchi Hostel
The staff were good especially Sami he was a friendly and welcoming and trying to solve the guest issues.
The total experience was good!
Good price!
The breakfast was Ok (a plate) and free coffee and tea (8am to 10:30 am)
Clean beds n bed sheets
The 6 bed room is located in the ground floor has one shared bath -But the room (smelly sometimes)
The 12 bed room is located upstairs and have two shared bathrooms
I forgot my hand bag in the bathroom then the housekeeping man found it and gave it to the front desk who gave it to me / thank you!

I was happy to book the double room with ensuite toilet for a good price. Room was very clean and everything was in order. Location was the best part as you could easily walk to the bazaars and new mosque. Breakfast was included. Nothing fancy but sufficient for you to start the day without eating too much, so that you have enough stomach space to eat other stuff.
Excellent stay near food street, metro is 1.1 KM and Hagia Sofia mosque, Egyptian market, Galata tower and Taqsim square are all accessible by walk/bus/metro.

I stayed one night in this hostel and all I can say is I am glad it was only one night. Only good thing about this hostel is the location and the bed in the dorm was comfortable and clean. But the room was very dark, there was no locker to put your valuables, the toilet was dirty and the receptionist felt depressed. I cannot recommend.

name: Stylish Hotel
location: Muhsine Hatun, Molataşı Cd. No:28, 34096 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: I spent 27 wonderful days at this hotel. Excellent service, clean rooms and bathrooms, and excellent staff, very friendly and polite, always willing to help!  As a woman traveling alone to Istanbul, I highly recommend it! Excellent service and very safe. Thanks for everything Stylish hotel!

We stayed for 4 days only but the experience has been wonderful. The accomodation is in strategic area, near the train station, you only need to walk 5-10 minutes. The staff is so warm and helpful. Shout out to Çetin and Hakan. Our room are clean and comfortable. It’s so recommended to book your accommodation here.

Very quiet comfortable bedroom (no noice). Big lobby / reception.  Always Stable hot water in the bathroom. The heating is working 24hours in the bedroom. Very Clean white bed sheets.   Uninterrupted wifi connection. Metro and tram is nearby. The Safety is high level at this hotel.
The room was pretty clean, the staff was super friendly and helpful. The location is great, I would reach everywhere within a 20 minute walk. Highly recommended

The hostel is conveniently located in the old town, there are many shops nearby to buy food, souvenirs and Turkish sweets. Not far from the bus station of the Havaist Aksaray company. There are mosques nearby. The hostel staff is very welcoming to its visitors, on the first floor there is a very large lobby where the kitchen is located, tea, coffee and sugar are provided free of charge, you can warm up food. The rooms are cozy, the linen is clean. I was lucky to be given
a room on the 4th floor, which offers a view of the Bosphorus and the beautiful tiled roofs of neighboring buildings. In general, in terms of price and quality, I am completely satisfied with this hostel and recommend the traveler to visit and stay in this hostel.

name: Avrasya Hostel
location: Cankurtaran, Seyit Hasan Sk. No:12, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
- first of all, manager slept in the 12 people room and his legs stinks. Could not sleep very well.
- in the morning art 6am they speak loud and wake up everyone, that's why I got up and started doing my routine. I accidentally opened up the sheet the manager was sleeping, in search of a charger place. He started shouting like crazy. I told him to calm down. He kept shouting. Then he told me to check out.

- VERY UNFRIENDLY PLACE. DON'T RECOMMEND

While not a 5 star hotel, it does offer private rooms that are functional, clean and safe.
There is a full kitchen and terrace area accessible at the top floor. The staff were trememdous : A fellow traveller advised what is an acceptable price for a cab from there to IST airport. The hostel arranged our taxi pickup at the correct/fair rate. The gentlemen there were extremely helpful and accomodating.
Ps...I forgot our power adapter in Athens and they lent us one they had from a few set aside for guests in need. To the owners, I apologize for not returning it. It was an oversight - honest mistake. You guys were great!

I usually write positive experience, but here I would like to be a bit honest.

-The Receptionist is 50 + person who is very rude, he himself don’t know, he gets hyper while speaking. Eg. They only take cash, he said, you can find another accommodation, if you don’t have cash. He is not Service Industry type personality , rather military negotiator.
-Kitchen-Is not hygienic with weird smell and fridge stinks with smell.

Terrace-There was a dead bird on terrace for 2 days. I highlighted the same, but they just ignored.

Location-Is only in their favour. Which is very close to Topkapi Palace and Hagia Sofia.

This hostel is really great! The staff are very friendly and always ready to help. The location is amazing, just next to the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque, so it’s easy to explore the city. The hostel has everything you need—clean rooms, a kitchen, and a nice common area. Plus, it’s super affordable. I would definitely stay here again!

We had a pleasant stay at Avrasya Hostel. The location is fantastic, right next to Ayasofya and Blue Mosque.
The price is very convenient, hence the four stars. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, which made our visit enjoyable. Our room was comfortable, not the cleanest, but once we asked to clean it, it was perfect, though the bathroom was a bit small. Unfortunately, the kitchen was quite dirty and messy. Despite this, we enjoyed the friendly atmosphere and the new friendships we made there.

Shout out to Ali for his enthusiasm that cheers up the whole hostel!

I would not recommend this hotel to an

2. Prime Location:

3. Elegant Rooms:
The rooms are beautifully decorated, blending Ottoman charm with modern amenities. Mine was clean, spacious, and offered a peaceful retreat after long days of exploring the city. The bed was particularly comfortable, and housekeeping maintained everything impeccably.

4. Panoramic Terrace:
One of the highlights is the rooftop terrace with stunning views of the Bosphorus and the historical skyline. It’s the perfect spot to enjoy a cup of Turkish tea or take pictures during sunrise or sunset.

5. Delicious Breakfast:
The breakfast buffet was varied and flavorful, featuring fresh fruits, local cheeses, traditional pastries, and Turkish specialties. The ambiance of the dining area was relaxed, and the service staff ensured everything was well-stocked and clean.

6. Great Value for Money:
Given the quality of service and location, Aruna Hotel offers excellent value. It’s a boutique hotel that delivers luxury without the high price tag.

I stayed in a 4 bed mixed dorm for 5 nights.

Pro- location is a 5-10 minute walk to Taksim Square from which the metro and funicular can be accessed to any area of the city. Price is affordable at around $10 per night (although there are many other hostels with a similar price point in the city also). Staff members were friendly, respectful and professional. Mattress and pillow were comfortable. Locker and individual hanger space provided the necessary space for all belongings (key included). Towel was included free of charge as was daily cleaning of each bed. If you don’t want your bed made or things moved around, just put a handmade sign on your bed! Place feels secure with a key code entry into the building and key card for individual room access. First floor common area is bright and spacious for socializing. Structure of the building is unique with the spiral staircase.

Challenges- First floor bathroom needs some work. The shower door was missing as was a holder for the shower head. Equally the toilet seat wouldn’t stay vertical and had to be manually held up. Kitchen could be improved. Located on the top floor, there was a water kettle, pots, pans, along with plates, cups and cutlery. However, there are no appliances for cooking with said items. Also, there was no space to eat apart from a table with 2 chairs on the outdoor balcony which is open to the weather elements. The cutlery drawer needs some repair as well as exposed nails are the primary way of opening the drawer. This is a simple fix along with repairing the shower door mentioned above that would be welcome. One last point is that in the 4 bed dorm, it is a 2 x 2 configuration. The top beds are easily accessible via the ladder with a cubby space and individual power socket. However, for the sleep rollers that are out there, a metal bar on the side of the bed would be a great addition so no one falls the 2 meters to the ground in the night.

It must be mentioned that the power was out for 2/5 mornings, making it an inconvenience and challenge to use the bathrooms or use the stairways safely due to the subsequent darkness. Not sure of the cause, but if this is a regular occurrence, it would be nice to have storm lights or something similar at the ready to place on each floor to help guests navigate when such times arise.

Poor location with awful services. The location is very cold during the winter time, as the heating radiator in my room was not working. To make it even more wierd, the hotel is located basically in a cemetery, so if you get a room on that side, you will see grave stones and people who visit their deads.  A bad general experience and a place where I would never return.

I stayed in a room wich has 6 beds. There is a small closet with a lock. The otel smells really bad. There are a a lot of cats And there is one or two bathrooms  for the hole otel!! I payed 70 turkish liras (18$) also there is nothing close to go like restaurants or café. There is just a bif cemetery near it

Very friendly and helpful. Management are willing to go the extra mile every time. The rooms are very clean and the beds are very comfortable. Location is brilliant, very close to everything. Next time i visit istanbul, Veni Vidi Dormi will be the only place i will be staying at. Playing playstation with Aras (manager) was the best part! Oh yh, very affordable as well. Would definitely recommend Veni Vidi! Thank you for everything!
a modest, historical, clean mansion. Very close to the central points. We stayed for 10 days, it was a cute experience

name: BARBAROSSA HOTEL
location: Cihannüma, Eski Yıldız Cd. No:34, 34400 Beşiktaş/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Scam.  Once you add the bank card information, they withdraw the amount without your consent.  Note that they state that no amount is deducted before arriving at the hotel.  When I try to communicate with them, they avoid and do not answer.  Officials in Türkiye must act on this rotten place!

This hotel is a BUG SCAM guys. Do not get a room here. You book based on these pics and this address then they will send you to another MOTEL. It is very dirty, small and awful. No hygiene standards are followed. Here are some pictures i took.

DON'T BOOK HERE...BIG SCAM! Never even got to stay here! Option was to pay at hotel on arrival. When we arrived we were greeted by a very unfriendly grumpy man, said our booking was cancelled and hotel was full. When we told him we had travelled all this way with 4 kids he shrugged his shoulders and refered us to another back street hotel which wanted to charge us more than double. Suspicions arose with an email sent before we arrived stating that the hotel was trying to take payment. Don't book here unless you want to be robbed, left on the street with no where to stay! Despicable.

Booked a room there with No prepayment and free cancellation, and they charged me full amount within 5 minutes. I cancelled it same time, and it’s been more than two month I don’t receive the refund. Scammers

I didn't stay in the hotel. I checked the room quality and services, as soon you enter the hotel entrance you will have clear idea about the quality.
It can be good choice for customers looking for only place to sleep.
Simply it's a shelter

name: ErenleR HoTeL & HosTeL
location: Hoca Paşa, Taya Hatun Sk No:9, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: The host is an amazing person and very kind. If you are travelling solo this hostel is for you at prime location and if you are coming with family there are family rooms also available.

I am staying in this hotel every time while visiting Istanbul since 2013. Best owners, top location and perfect price. Everything cosy and clean.
Very friendly and helpful gentlemen owning the place.
Will come back for sure

Stayed a few nights while visiting Istanbul. What a fantastic find at a great price. The owner was super nice and let me check in early, everything was clean and well maintained. Great location, thanks for everything!

It's in a very good location. A lot of the main tourist attractions are all closeby and there is a tram stop close by. My one criticism about the location is that the restaurants closely nearby are really expensive , and the turkish delight/lokum shops have a tendency to overcharge (up to 4x) and scam their customers (mainly naive tourists I assume), so Id reccomend travelling further towards the spice bazaar area for food and/or delights. The facilities are very well maintained and are clean, the toilet and showers are all clean also.The owner is a very nice man who is very hospitable and a pleasure to deal with. The single rooms are perfect for a solo traveller on a budget.
Nice place. Rooms are clean, staff is friendly and welcoming. Location is amazing, hagia sophia and lots of other places you would like to visit are really near.

editorial_summary: Compact rooms in an unpretentious budget hotel offering free Wi-Fi & a communal TV lounge.

name: Sultanahmet Hotel Han
location: Alemdar, Yerebatan Cd. No:19, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: We loved our stay in Han Hotel. Our room got upgraded which was such a great surprise! Although it was located on the third floor, we were helped by the staff to bring our luggages up. It’s actually located behind restaurants in the middle of Sulanahmet which is near Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque and a beautiful park. It’s perfect if you want peace and quiet and not really packed like other parts in Istanbul. The nearest public transpo is around 5-10 mins by foot, not bad as well. The room seemed like it was new and renovated. It was clean. They had a simple breakfast but enough to be filling. It’s not as busy as Taksim and only a few bars open at night, perfect if you want quiet. Would recommend!!
Best budget hotel, located close to all important tourist places. Safe for solo women traveller as well. The staff was welcoming and very cooperative

My goal was just spend one night in a place. Therefore I will write a review depending on that.

Advantages
* Location was really nice. Everywhere was so close to one another yo visit.
* Staff was just normal. Not so good, not bad.
* Breakfast was nice if you will compare with the price of hotel (I paid 21€ per night)
* Air conditioner was working well

Dezadvantages
* The bed was 2 different level
* The water pressure was not enough to take a shower

Im gonna give it a 5 star. Place was ok. Very basic, but I everything was clean, bed was comfortable and location was absolutely amazing. If it was any closer to center, you would be sleeping in a Hagia Sophia.

Hotel was very affordable, and for that price really you cant ask for more.

Restraint of this hotel was expensive, and would not recommend dining there for that reason only. You have much more affordable places just little outside of this place.  Like, bottle of water was 4,2$. That is just ridiculous. Food was very good though.

Fantastic location, basic rooms with the essentials, and decent simple breakfast, but the shower water and Wi-fi both suffered from consistency issues. Still pretty nice for the price (roughly 60 USD per night for the smallest room prepaid in August 2023).

Without even moving the handle, the shower water oscillates between scalding hot and lukewarm. The Wi-fi connection to the internet is also spotty, which is inconvenient.

editorial_summary: Casual rooms in a polished boutique property featuring a cozy restaurant with a street-view terrace.

name: Han Suite Hotel
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Küçük Ayasofya Camii Sokagi no :12, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
There were bed bugs in our room. Woke up the next day with horrible bed bug bites and their remnants. The front desk was not accessible during our stay.  The room also had the water seeping UP from the drain. While we stayed, it rained and dirty water from the bathroom sewage overflowed our room. The hotel staff was kind enough to give us a new room at a different hotel, but I am afraid even that hotel had bed bugs.
Other than the few cons I mentioned, it is an ok hotel in an ok neighborhood, but I repeat again that you should be aware of the bed bugs.

Han suite hotel located near sultan ahmed stations actually it’s good location but the things is, you need to take a walk around 15 minutes to get the property. And the track it’s not good if you bring the heavy and big luggage.

The room was filthy when we arrived and the sheets weee ripped and had just been  stitches in some places.
The fridge and shower disgusting. Never ever will I be staying there again.

The hotel is very neglected and the rooms are dirty. At first glance, the rooms look nicely finished, but this is only a pretense. The towels were dirty, the bedding stank of another guy and you could smell and see mold everywhere....
We asked a staff member (who was very polite, nice and tried to help) to change the bedding and towels, unfortunately he told us that there was nothing else, instead he offered us another room, which was only a little cleaner. After one night we moved out of there.
I recommend avoiding this place!

We stayed at Han Suite Hotel with my wife for a three-day stay in Istanbul, and I would like to share my experience. The accommodation is located at Küçük Ayasofya Mahallesi, Küçük Ayasofya Camii Sokagi No. 12, 34122 Fatih/Istanbul.

Although the hotel room was small, it was exceptionally tidy, providing us with a comfortable stay. The hotel staff stood out with their kindness and helpfulness, always ready to assist and provide information about the city.

We were informed in advance that the hotel has private parking, but unfortunately, the capacity was limited to just one parallel parking space on the sidewalk in front of the hotel, suitable only for smaller city cars.

We particularly enjoyed the hotel's rooftop terrace, which was accessible to guests 24/7. The view of the city from the terrace was enchanting, providing us with a beautiful backdrop for relaxation and enjoyment.

Regarding the accommodation price, I consider it very reasonable compared to the quality of service. My overall rating for the stay would be 9/10, highlighting the cleanliness of the hotel with a score of 9/10, the kindness and helpfulness of the staff with a high score of 10/10, and the value for money with a score of 9/10.

All in all, Han Suite Hotel provided us with a pleasant accommodation experience in Istanbul, with friendly staff and an attractive rooftop terrace. I would recommend it to others looking for a comfortable stay at an affordable price.

name: The Print House Hotel
location: Alemdar, Güzelsanatlar Sk. No:5, 34110 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Check in was horrible. Front desk staff was not helpful and spoke no English. No elevator. Rooms ok but service is bad. Do yourself a favor and book elsewhere. Spare yourself the risk of getting there and they tell you they are over sold!

This boutique hotel is simple, cute, and extremely comfortable. The staff is friendly and welcoming. The room is very clean, large in space with air conditioning and free fast WI-FI.  The location is outstanding near every attraction,  public transportation,  and most importantly, restaurants and shops. You can safely walk to everything day or night. Love this hotel. I recommend it and will stay   here on our next visit.
Good luck with your search, and enjoy your time in Istanbul.
Regards
David

Check in was poor. Bad communication and manager was so rude!

The chap at reception (who couldn't speak English at all) had to call the manager as me and my husband had been allocated a twin  bed room (2 single beds). The Print House had confirmed by email a double bed room on the third floor back on 23rd June 2024.

The manager was argumentative and eventually agreed to give a different room the day after. This was only when a picture message from my phone was sent to him as proof.

No room was given the next day.

Just based of the service and tone of the manager. I would not stay here again!

Easy 5 stars. Place was really central yet quiet and also clean. Everyday we were there they cleaned and changed towels. The reception was so warm and welcoming. The breakfast was amazing on the lovely roof terrace. There are a lot of stairs and no lift which was fine for me but you'll want to ask for a lower floor if you have mobility needs.
The room looks better in real life by the way!

This hotel is such value for money…. For the price- it has a fridge, tea& coffee making facilities and wonderful hosts.
The young couple who run the place are very helpful esp the lady- she makes fresh cake every day for breakfast& nothing is an effort for her.
The Hotel doesn’t have good access -the taxi cannot drop you in front of the door and it has lots of stairs to climb but that seems to be the problem most all Hotels in Sultanahmed.
The roof of the hotel has views of the  Hagia & the Blue mosque and is easily accessed.
I highly recommend this Hotel

editorial_summary: Warm rooms with hardwood floors & free Wi-Fi in an intimate hotel in a converted printing house.

name: Valens Boutique Hotel
location: Cerrahpaşa, Mihri Hatun Sk. No:3, 34098 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: We booked at this hotel at the last minute and are very grateful to them for providing a comfortable room, a delicious breakfast, and helping us get to the airport on time the following morning! Just across the highway from the ancient wall on the edge of the sea, beautiful place for a walk or a run.

I am very happy with the people who are working here!!Very hospitable and very friendly environment! Everyday hosts invite me to drink a turkish tea and we had very friendly conversations and good atmosphere with Abdullah👍

Very nice beautiful staff , I like them,
This is my 2nd time in the hotel, Akram one of the staff he is very nice and helpful,
Very nice hotel
Narrow rooms and very smelly

name: Blue Ottoman Hotel
location: Sultan Ahmet, Tavukhane Sk. NO:13, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: This charming hotel truly exceeded our expectations . Although we only stayed for one night (we didn't have more time), we can confidently say that this hotel is definitely worth a visit. The location couldn't be better – situated right in the center, in a traditional neighborhood, allowing you to visit all the sights on foot. Moreover, it's located right next to the stunning Blue Mosque, offering a breathtaking view in the evening. The staff was very attentive and friendly. Our hotel room was beautiful and clean. And the icing on the cake was the hotel breakfast served on the rooftop, with a stunning view of the entire Istanbul. We can really recommend this hotel

Nice person from staff !
My parents stayed at this hotel in February, and I got in touch with the hotel's Staff to ask them a service...to figure out for me a little surprise for my father who was having his birthday during the stay. The person from the staff was really kind and helpful, really really cool and found out and organized for me a little surprise to my father (he or she found or bought some chocolate) for my father ! And I was really happy about this kind gesture ! Thank you a lot !

This was by far the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had, and I strongly advise others to avoid this property.

I initially booked a 4-night stay with my family, including my 4-year-old child. Upon check-in, I was told to pay in cash the next morning. However, the services listed on Booking.com were not available in the room. When I raised the issue with the receptionist, I was told the manager was not present. I also left a message through Booking.com to report the situation.

Later that morning, the manager called me and began harassing me—threatening to throw my belongings out of the room if I didn’t return by 12 PM. I repeatedly explained that I needed time to find an alternative property and that I was traveling with a small child, but he was aggressive, rude, and completely unprofessional.

I was forced to return to the hotel and pay for the one night I stayed (via credit card), but I was not provided with an invoice. To make matters worse, the manager then cancelled my entire 4-night booking on Booking.com, likely to avoid negative feedback.

It was an extremely distressing and unacceptable experience, especially with a young child. I felt harassed and unsafe. I had to urgently find another hotel at a much higher cost.

Booking.com, unfortunately, has not been able to resolve this situation or hold the property accountable, which is disappointing as a loyal Genius member.

I do not recommend this hotel to anyone and urge Booking.com to reconsider working with such a property.

Everything was great about the place the location, room facilities, cleaning and most of all the staff that runs this place. Everyone is warm and welcoming and don't feel like a stranger. Highly recommended if you are visiting Istanbul!

We stayed at this hotel for five days.

The location was excellent, the employees were very polite, welcoming, helpful & they spoke good English and Russian. The rooms were clean and the breakfast in the roof top was nice, it had a very beautiful view and the food was good.

The drawbacks were that our room key lock had some problems so we could not lock the door but nothing was stolen from our room, and they fixed it. Also one day, I tried to take a shower in the morning and there was no hot water for like 45 minutes, but these things are minor and the overall stay was very pleasant.

They changed the bedsheets and towels regularly, and whenever we asked for extra towels, shampoo and shower gel they immediately gave us.

The room was a little small and it came with a hair dryer and a kettle. They also provided one big bottle of water with the room. The room came with a shampoo, shower gel, toilet paper, towels but no conditioner or tissue box.

There is no safe lock box. There is a school in front of the hotel but it was not noisy. In fact, the school had a beautiful music when the classes finishes instead of a bell which was very beautiful and we were actually looking forward when the class finishes to hear this beautiful music.

Overall, we were happy and I will come back again to this hotel next time I will visit Istanbul.

name: RİVERSİDE HOTEL
location: Yavuz Sinan, Küçük Pazar Cd. no:1 1, 34134 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment:
On second night of two night stay, I was told I'd have to move hotels and if I didn't move, they'd move my belongings for me. Then after I refused, they forced me to move to a different room in same hotel. Then they tried to cancel my booking so I couldn't leave a bad review.

They smile, and stab you in the back. Beware.

I booked a regular room on Booking.com. Since I am not able to leave review on that platform as Hotel closed that option I am leaving feedback here. Therefore rating on booking.com is completely misleading since genuine customers can’t leave feedback.

When I choose place to stay I keep attention to certain details.

In the description it was mentioned: soundproof, view, city view.

View - I expected to have a window as on the photos. However they gave a room without a window. Tiny one. The wall separating it from the next room was made of paper. I could hear absolutely everything what was happening there. After back and forth messages with manager they agreed to give me a room with the window. Solution - list room without a window as a separate option and a cheaper one. People who prefer to save money will choose it willingly, knowing that there is no window. It is a bad strategy give those rooms to customers and if they complain fix the situation.

Soundproof - please remove this statement from your description as it’s absolutely misleading. I could hear everything what was happening in the room next to mine. Running water, people switching on and off lights and all what they were talking about and not only that. Windows were not properly adjusted and closed so I could hear everything what was happening outside as well.

Some good points: Clean, white towels and bedding, hot water. The area is very local and isn’t pretty but it’s convenient, in the central part of the city, easy access to everything.

I recently stayed at the Riverside Hotel in Istanbul for six nights, and I had a wonderful experience. The price was excellent, offering great value for money. The hotel’s location is a major highlight—very close to downtown and within walking distance of the Grand Bazaar, making it incredibly convenient for exploring the city.

A special mention goes to Mr. Talha, the receptionist, who was exceptionally polite and helpful throughout my stay. His professionalism and friendly demeanor added a personal touch to the overall experience.

I would highly recommend the Riverside Hotel to anyone visiting Istanbul for its affordability, prime location, and outstanding service. I look forward to staying here again in the future!

Attractive although questionable renovation in the Vefa neighborhood. Many rooms on this property are without windows and you never know what you are booking.

Curtain that appears to be a window is an opening to a basement ventilation shaft.

Friendly Turkish speaking staff. Close to public transportation.

Owners response: Why do you write anonymously are you ashamed by photos of your hotel?
It is not difficult to find fault with this property, If it is preferred additional photos can be posted.
My review was very considerate and generous and the owner's response is typical of the poor guest relations experienced at this location.
The head desk clerk Yusef was immediately notified that a room without a window was not acceptable and no action was taken to rectify the situation. He pointed to the ventilation shaft and indicated that was the window. Zero natural light and musty odor arising from the basement.
If you are selling rooms without windows it should be clearly stated not as a surprise at check in. Also the hotel was notified immediately by Hotels.com that a room without a window was not satisfactory.
This review is not an attempt to discredit anyone and is simply an exercise in honesty so other travelers can avoid this unpleasant experience.
“Speak the truth even if it is bitter.” (Hadith)
“The truth appears to be hate to those who hate the truth.” (Proverb)
Beware of manufactured reviews.

The hotel is excellent, it has a good location, you won't need more than half an hour's drive to walk around all the sights, there is a public transport nearby: Bus station, metro and railway.  The staff is too polite and at your disposal for any need.  Many thanks to the receptionist Talha for the advice and directions he gave us, they were of great help to organize ourselves better 😁 I kindly recimended for every one

name: Sareban Hotel Istanbul
location: Küçük Ayasofya, Cinci Meydanı Sk. No:12, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Türkiye

reviews.comment: Emir, you have a beautiful hotel! My first trip to Istanbul went great! We were treated to a delicious tea when we first arrived. Made a nice surprise as a dessert. Room with a beautiful view! Excellent service staff! Clean and cozy! We will only stay with you!

I stayed at the hotel in March this year. The room was small but very comfortable, and it didn’t cause any inconvenience. The hotel itself is small, cozy, and has a pleasant atmosphere. The staff were very polite and attentive – excellent service overall. I especially appreciated the convenient location: everything you need is nearby, yet the area is peaceful and quiet. A perfect place for a comfortable and relaxing stay.

Perfect Stay – Highly Recommended!
We had a wonderful stay at Hotel Sareban! The location is absolutely perfect – just a short walk to the heart of Sultanahmet, and super convenient to reach the metro and other key attractions around Istanbul. The area is peaceful and safe, ideal for relaxing after a day of sightseeing.
Our room was clean, cozy, and very comfortable. Housekeeping came daily and changed the linens, which was a great touch. We were lucky enough to have a stunning view of the Bosphorus from our window – truly breathtaking!
What truly made our stay special was Emir, the owner. He was incredibly kind, helpful, and always ready with a smile. On my mother’s birthday, he even surprised us with a cake and beautiful roses in the room – such a thoughtful and unforgettable gesture!
Hotel Sareban is a hidden gem. Super approved and highly recommended – we’d definitely stay here again!

The location is perfect, within walking distance of Istanbul’s main attractions.
A special thanks to Emir and Mohamed, who were incredibly attentive and gave us excellent tips to explore the city like locals.
The room exceeded our expectations—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, providing the perfect retreat after a day of sightseeing.
Without a doubt, when we return to Istanbul, Sareban will be our go-to hotel. Highly recommended!

The hotel room was very nice and comfortable. They cleaned are rooms everyday. The staff was soo friendly and kind and they helped us so much with some problems that we had during our stay in Istanbul. They even arranged us a taxi to take us to the airport. So worth it
